test_parse_datetime: test the parse_datetime function to parse ISO 8601 datetime strings with milliseconds and UTC timezone
test_parse_datetime_nanoseconds: test parse_datetime truncates nanosecond precision to microseconds correctly
test_parse_datetime_no_milliseconds: test parse_datetime handles datetime strings without milliseconds by adding zero microseconds
test_parse_datetime_invalid_no_tz: test parse_datetime raises ValueError for ISO 8601 strings missing timezone indicator
test_parse_datetime_invalid_malformed: test parse_datetime raises ValueError for malformed datetime strings with invalid formats
